scenario.name: Riverton Meal Mission
assumptions: Entire scenario, names, priorities and coefficients are synthetic.
Each order is indivisible; loading takes 120 seconds. Initial routes make one trip; recovery permits at most one depot reload per healthy vehicle.
Cold-chain is vehicle compatibility only; no food-safety certification claim.
Roads are directed; shortest travel-time paths are used. Vehicles must return before their original shifts end.
Cost is distance × cents/km; emissions are distance × grams CO2e/km, rounded per vehicle. No fixed or service costs are modeled.
Planning wall time does not advance scenario time. Failed cargo is stranded without rescue or transfer.

solver.objective: Integer distance metres + meal omission penalties + service-start tardiness seconds; proxy objective, not exact on-time coverage.
